from manim import *
import numpy as np

class WalkingAgent5(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#87CEEB"
        
        time_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        floor = Line(LEFT*10, RIGHT*10, color="#228B22", stroke_width=80).shift(DOWN*3.5)
        self.add(floor)
        
        def create_tree():
            trunk = Rectangle(width=0.4, height=1.5, color="#8B4513", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0)
            leaves = Polygon(
                UP*1.5, LEFT*1.5 + DOWN*0.5, RIGHT*1.5 + DOWN*0.5,
                color="#006400", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0
            ).next_to(trunk, UP, buff=-0.5)
            return VGroup(trunk, leaves)

        def create_cloud():
            c1 = Circle(radius=0.5, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0)
            c2 = Circle(radius=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0).next_to(c1, RIGHT, buff=-0.3).shift(UP*0.2)
            c3 = Circle(radius=0.6, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0).next_to(c2, RIGHT, buff=-0.4).shift(DOWN*0.1)
            return VGroup(c1, c2, c3)
        
        tree_start_x = [i * 6 - 8 for i in range(6)]
        cloud_start_x = [i * 5 - 7 for i in range(7)]
        
        trees = VGroup(*[create_tree() for _ in range(6)])
        clouds = VGroup(*[create_cloud() for _ in range(7)])
        
        bg_group = VGroup(trees, clouds)
        self.add(bg_group)
        
        def update_bg(mob):
            t = time_tracker.get_value()
            for i, tree in enumerate(trees):
                x = (tree_start_x[i] - t * 4) % 36 - 18
                tree.move_to(np.array([x, -1.8, 0]))
            for i, cloud in enumerate(clouds):
                x = (cloud_start_x[i] - t * 2) % 35 - 17
                y = 2 + (i % 2)
                cloud.move_to(np.array([x, y, 0]))
                
        bg_group.add_updater(update_bg)
        
        head_radius = 0.8
        head = Circle(radius=head_radius, color=BLACK, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=8)
        
        eye_l = Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1)
        eye_r = Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1)
        
        smile = Arc(radius=0.4, start_angle=5*PI/4, angle=PI/2, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        
        laugh_mouth = Sector(outer_radius=0.4, angle=PI, start_angle=PI, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1)
        laugh_mouth.stretch(0.7, dim=1)
        laugh_mouth.set_opacity(0)
        
        face = VGroup(eye_l, eye_r, smile, laugh_mouth)
        head_group = VGroup(head, face)
        
        torso = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.3, width=0.7, height=1.6, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, color=BLACK, stroke_width=8)
        
        arm_l_upper = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=10)
        arm_l_lower = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=10)
        
        arm_r_upper = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=10)
        arm_r_lower = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=10)
        
        leg_l_upper = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=12)
        leg_l_lower = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=12)
        
        leg_r_upper = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=12)
        leg_r_lower = Line(ORIGIN, DOWN, color=BLACK, stroke_width=12)
        
        stickman = VGroup(
            arm_r_upper, arm_r_lower,
            leg_r_upper, leg_r_lower,
            torso, head_group,
            leg_l_upper, leg_l_lower,
            arm_l_upper, arm_l_lower
        )
        self.add(stickman)
        
        def update_stickman(mob):
            t = time_tracker.get_value()
            freq = 2 * PI * 1.5 
            phase = t * freq
            
            bounce = abs(np.sin(phase)) * 0.3
            root_pos = DOWN * 0.2 + UP * bounce
            
            torso.move_to(root_pos + UP*0.8)
            head_group.move_to(torso.get_top() + UP*(head_radius - 0.1))
            
            eye_pos_l = head.get_center() + UP*0.1 + LEFT*0.25
            eye_pos_r = head.get_center() + UP*0.1 + RIGHT*0.25
            
            if (t % 3.0) < 0.15:
                eye_l.become(Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1).stretch(0.1, dim=1).move_to(eye_pos_l))
                eye_r.become(Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1).stretch(0.1, dim=1).move_to(eye_pos_r))
            else:
                eye_l.become(Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1).move_to(eye_pos_l))
                eye_r.become(Circle(radius=0.1, color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1).move_to(eye_pos_r))
                
            smile.move_to(head.get_center() + DOWN*0.2)
            laugh_mouth.move_to(head.get_center() + DOWN*0.25)
            
            hips = torso.get_bottom() + UP*0.2
            shoulders = torso.get_top() + DOWN*0.3
            
            r_leg_angle = np.sin(phase + PI) * 0.8
            leg_r_upper.put_start_and_end_on(hips + RIGHT*0.15, hips + RIGHT*0.15 + np.array([np.sin(r_leg_angle), -np.cos(r_leg_angle), 0]) * 0.9)
            knee_flex_r = max(0, -np.sin(phase + PI)) * 1.2
            r_ankle = leg_r_upper.get_end() + np.array([np.sin(r_leg_angle - knee_flex_r), -np.cos(r_leg_angle - knee_flex_r), 0]) * 0.9
            leg_r_lower.put_start_and_end_on(leg_r_upper.get_end(), r_ankle)

            l_leg_angle = np.sin(phase) * 0.8
            leg_l_upper.put_start_and_end_on(hips + LEFT*0.15, hips + LEFT*0.15 + np.array([np.sin(l_leg_angle), -np.cos(l_leg_angle), 0]) * 0.9)
            knee_flex_l = max(0, -np.sin(phase)) * 1.2
            l_ankle = leg_l_upper.get_end() + np.array([np.sin(l_leg_angle - knee_flex_l), -np.cos(l_leg_angle - knee_flex_l), 0]) * 0.9
            leg_l_lower.put_start_and_end_on(leg_l_upper.get_end(), l_ankle)
            
            r_arm_angle = np.sin(phase) * 0.7
            arm_r_upper.put_start_and_end_on(shoulders + RIGHT*0.25, shoulders + RIGHT*0.25 + np.array([np.sin(r_arm_angle), -np.cos(r_arm_angle), 0]) * 0.7)
            elbow_flex_r = max(0, np.sin(phase)) * 0.8 + 0.1
            arm_r_lower.put_start_and_end_on(arm_r_upper.get_end(), arm_r_upper.get_end() + np.array([np.sin(r_arm_angle + elbow_flex_r), -np.cos(r_arm_angle + elbow_flex_r), 0]) * 0.7)
            
            l_arm_angle = np.sin(phase + PI) * 0.7
            arm_l_upper.put_start_and_end_on(shoulders + LEFT*0.25, shoulders + LEFT*0.25 + np.array([np.sin(l_arm_angle), -np.cos(l_arm_angle), 0]) * 0.7)
            elbow_flex_l = max(0, np.sin(phase + PI)) * 0.8 + 0.1
            arm_l_lower.put_start_and_end_on(arm_l_upper.get_end(), arm_l_upper.get_end() + np.array([np.sin(l_arm_angle + elbow_flex_l), -np.cos(l_arm_angle + elbow_flex_l), 0]) * 0.7)
            
        stickman.add_updater(update_stickman)
        
        self.play(time_tracker.animate.set_value(2), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        
        self.play(
            smile.animate.set_opacity(0),
            laugh_mouth.animate.set_opacity(1),
            time_tracker.animate.set_value(3),
            run_time=1,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        
        self.play(time_tracker.animate.set_value(6), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
